name: Houston
industries: Energy megaprojects and the transition portfolio dominate, alongside the world's largest medical-center complex.
intro:
Houston runs the world's energy projects: upstream megaprojects, the petrochemical corridor along the Ship Channel, and now the energy transition — carbon capture, hydrogen, LNG expansion — all managed from this city. Project management here is a formal engineering discipline, and PMP is its lingua franca, from operator PMOs to the EPC contractors lining the Energy Corridor. The Texas Medical Center, the world's largest, adds healthcare program demand. We run live online cohorts throughout the year on Houston-friendly hours — weekend Saturday–Sunday batches and midweek Wednesday–Thursday batches both — meaning learners in Houston attend at ordinary local times, never overnight; the table below shows each upcoming date converted for Houston. The package doesn't change: live weekend instruction, exam application guidance, full-length mock exams, and trainer access until you pass.

Houston runs the largest capital-project complex in North America: energy majors, EPC contractors and the medical-center institutions all deliver through stage-gated governance where certified project leadership is a structural requirement, not a preference. Energy-transition programs are adding a second wave of demand on top of traditional oil-and-gas delivery. Training is live online across two consecutive days in Central time — Houston's clock — with no venue commute on the Katy Freeway. Energy-sector project compensation has its own scale; the sourced Houston entries below quantify it with named sources and dates. The employer list reflects the energy-EPC-healthcare base, and contractors staffing up for new awards can certify project teams through private cohorts.
